prelaunch_correction: Accept equivalent torch.device Metal spellings mps and mps:0; reject CPU. Corrected before any joint GPU inference; candidate decisions unchanged.
scope: One exposed crowded anonymous-birth control: six named initial masks, all eight truth animals, and seconds 0–1529 only. No reserved pixels, name acquisition, threshold fitting or retirement.
scoring: Retain all eight animals in the full panels 330–629, 930–1229 and 1230–1529. New slots use cow=None bookkeeping, never a guessed publisher identity. Count every named unmatched box as an error. An incomplete control is reported as failed, without misleading full-panel rates.
timing: frame_seconds measures propagation, same-frame SAM, naming decisions and mask writes. It excludes source decode/hash before the loop body and Metal cache reclamation after the timer. Overall elapsed includes initialization, source decode/hash and reclamation, but is set before the final report write. Detector cache fill is separately measured. The unchanged one-second sustained frame_seconds cap is a safety guard, not a claim of complete live 2 fps throughput.
